    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Computer use<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<div id="gemini-api-switcher-trigger" style="display:none;"></div>

<p>
</p>

<p></p>



























































<p>The Computer Use tool lets you build browser, mobile, and desktop control agents
that interact with and automate tasks. Using screenshots, the model can &quot;see&quot; a
computer screen, and &quot;act&quot; by generating specific UI actions like mouse clicks
and keyboard inputs. Similar to function calling, you will need to implement the
client-side execution environment to receive and execute the Computer Use
actions.</p>

<p>For the list of supported models, see <a href="#model-versions">Model versions</a>. The Gemini 3.x models support several advanced capabilities:</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Multi-environment support:</strong> build agents for <a href="#supported-environments">browser, mobile, and desktop</a> environments.</li>
<li><strong>Streamlined actions with intents:</strong> actions include an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">intent</code> field that explains the model&#39;s reasoning behind each step.</li>
<li><strong>Configurable safety policies:</strong> fine-tune <a href="#safety-policies">safety behavior</a> with built-in policy categories and overrides.</li>
<li><strong>Prompt injection detection:</strong> opt-in <a href="#prompt-injection">screenshot scanning</a> to detect hidden adversarial instructions.</li>
</ul>

<p>With Computer Use, you can build agents that:</p>

<ul>
<li>Automate repetitive data entry or form filling on websites.</li>
<li>Perform automated testing of web applications and user flows</li>
<li>Conduct research across various websites (e.g., gathering product
information, prices, and reviews from ecommerce sites to inform a purchase)</li>
</ul>

<p>Here&#39;s a minimal example of initializing the client and sending a prompt to the model with the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">computer_use</code> tool enabled for a browser environment:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Search for 'Gemini API' on Google."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"environment"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'@google/genai'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.7-flash'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Search for 'Gemini API' on Google."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="java" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Java"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> As a Preview capability, Computer Use may contain errors and security
vulnerabilities. We recommend supervising closely for important tasks, and that
you avoid using the Computer Use capability for tasks involving critical
decisions, sensitive data, or actions where serious errors cannot be corrected.
We encourage you to review the <a href="#safety-best-practices">Safety best practices</a>,
the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy">Prohibited Use
Policy</a> and <a href="/terms">Gemini
API Additional Terms of Service</a>.</span></aside>
<h2 id="how-computer-use" data-text="How Computer Use works" tabindex="-1">How Computer Use works</h2>

<p>To build an agent with the Computer Use model, you need to set up a
continuous loop between your application and the API. Here is what your code
will do at each step:</p>

<ol>
<li><a href="#send-request"><strong>Send a request to the model</strong></a>
<ul>
<li>Your application sends an API request containing the Computer Use tool,
your configuration settings (like the target environment), the user&#39;s
prompt, and a screenshot of the current screen.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><a href="#model-response"><strong>Receive the model response</strong></a>
<ul>
<li>The model analyzes the screen and the prompt, returning a response
which includes a suggested <code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_call</code> representing a UI action (such
as a click, scroll, or keystroke).</li>
<li>For <strong>Gemini 3.x models</strong>, the response also includes a reasoning <code translate="no" dir="ltr">intent</code>
explaining why the model chose that action.</li>
<li>The response may also include a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">safety_decision</code> from an internal safety
system that classifies the action as regular/allowed,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">require_confirmation</code> (requiring user approval), or blocked.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><a href="#execute-actions"><strong>Execute the received action</strong></a>
<ul>
<li>If the action is allowed (or the user confirms it), your client-side
code parses the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_call</code>, scales the normalized coordinates to match
your viewport, and executes the action in your target environment using
automation tools (such as Playwright). If the action is blocked, your
client should halt the execution or handle the interruption.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><a href="#capture-state"><strong>Capture the new environment state</strong></a>
<ul>
<li>After the action finishes executing, your application captures a new
screenshot and sends it back to the model in a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_result</code> to
request the next step.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>

<p>This process then repeats from step 2, continually soliciting the next action
from the model until the task is completed or terminated.</p>

<p><img src="/static/gemini-api/docs/images/computer_use.png" alt="Computer Use overview"></p>

<h2 id="implement-computer-use" data-text="How to implement Computer Use" tabindex="-1">How to implement Computer Use</h2>

<p>Before building with the Computer Use tool you will need to set up:</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Secure execution environment:</strong> Run your agent in a sandboxed VM or
container to isolate it from your host system and limit its potential impact.
The <a href="https://github.com/google/computer-use-preview/">reference implementation</a>
includes a ready-to-use Docker-based sandbox you can use as a starting point.</li>
<li><strong>Client-side action handler:</strong> Implement client-side logic to execute coordinates, type text, and take screenshots.</li>
</ul>

<p>The examples below use a web browser as the execution environment and
<a href="https://playwright.dev/">Playwright</a> as the client-side handler.</p>

<h3 id="0_set_up_playwright" data-text="0. Set up Playwright" tabindex="-1">0. Set up Playwright</h3>

<p>First, install the required packages:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pip<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>google-genai<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>playwright
playwright<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>chromium
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Then, initialize a Playwright browser instance to use for execution:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">playwright.sync_api</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">sync_playwright</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 1. Configure screen dimensions for the target environment</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">SCREEN_WIDTH</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">1440</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">SCREEN_HEIGHT</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">900</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 2. Start the Playwright browser</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># In production, utilize a sandboxed environment.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">playwright</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">sync_playwright</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">start</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Set headless=False to see the actions performed on your screen</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">browser</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">playwright</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">chromium</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">launch</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">headless</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">False</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 3. Create a context and page with the specified dimensions</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">context</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">browser</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">new_context</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">viewport</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"width"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">SCREEN_WIDTH</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"height"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">SCREEN_HEIGHT</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">page</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">context</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">new_page</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 4. Navigate to an initial page to start the task</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">page</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">goto</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://www.google.com"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># The 'page', 'SCREEN_WIDTH', and 'SCREEN_HEIGHT' variables</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># will be used in the steps below.</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<h3 id="send-request" data-text="1. Send a request to the model" tabindex="-1">1. Send a request to the model</h3>

<p>Initialize the client library and configure the Computer Use tool. Note that there is no need to specify the display size when issuing a request; the model predicts pixel coordinates scaled to the height and width of the screen.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="gemini-3.x" data-text="Gemini 3.x" tabindex="-1">Gemini 3.x</h3><div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_1" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><p>Use the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">google-genai</code> Python SDK (version <code translate="no" dir="ltr">2.7.0</code> or higher) to configure a request targeting the browser environment:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.7-flash'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Find a flight from SF to Hawaii on Jun 30th, coming back on Jul 6th"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"environment"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"enable_prompt_injection_detection"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_1" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><p>Use the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">@google/genai</code> Node.js SDK to configure a request targeting the browser environment:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'@google/genai'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.7-flash'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Find a flight from SF to Hawaii on Jun 30th, coming back on Jul 6th"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">enable_prompt_injection_detection</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">true</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div></section>
<section><h3 id="java_1" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Java"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">java.util.Arrays</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<h3 id="model-response" data-text="2. Receive the model response" tabindex="-1">2. Receive the model response</h3>

following shows examples of both responses:</p>

<h3 id="capture-state" data-text="4. Capture the new environment state" tabindex="-1">4. Capture the new environment state</h3>

<p>After executing the actions, send the result of the function execution back to
the model so it can use this information to generate the next action. If
multiple actions (parallel calls) were executed, you must send a
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_result</code> for each one in the subsequent user turn.</p>

<p>Once you have defined how to capture and format the environment state, you can
combine all these steps into a continuous execution loop.</p>

<h2 id="agent-loop" data-text="Build an agent loop" tabindex="-1">Build an agent loop</h2>

<p>To enable multi-step interactions, combine the four steps from the <a href="#implement-computer-use">How to
implement Computer Use</a> section into a single loop.
This loop continues requesting actions and feeding the results back to the model
until the task is complete.</p>

<p>Remember to manage the conversation history correctly by appending both the
model responses and your function responses to the history at each step.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">playwright.sync_api</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">sync_playwright</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<h2 id="supported-environments" data-text="Supported environments (Gemini 3.x)" tabindex="-1">Supported environments (Gemini 3.x)</h2>

<p>Gemini 3.x models support three environments specified in the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">computer_use</code>
configurations:</p>

<tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>navigate</strong></td>

</table>

<h2 id="legacy-supported-actions" data-text="Legacy Supported UI actions (Gemini 2.5)" tabindex="-1">Legacy Supported UI actions (Gemini 2.5)</h2>

<p>For legacy models (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-2.5-computer-use-preview-10-2025</code>), the following actions are supported:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Command name</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Arguments (in function call)</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Example function call</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>open_web_browser</strong></td>

<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;open_web_browser&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>wait_5_seconds</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Pauses execution for 5 seconds.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">None</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;wait_5_seconds&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>go_back</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Navigates to the previous page in history.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">None</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;go_back&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>go_forward</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Navigates to the next page in history.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">None</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;go_forward&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>search</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Navigates to default search engine.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">None</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;search&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>navigate</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Navigates the browser directly to the specified URL.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">url</code>: str</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;navigate&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://www.wikipedia.org&quot;}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>click_at</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Clicks at a specific coordinate.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">y</code>: int (0-999), <code translate="no" dir="ltr">x</code>: int (0-999)</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;click_at&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;y&quot;: 300, &quot;x&quot;: 500}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>hover_at</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Hovers mouse at a specific coordinate.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">y</code>: int (0-999), <code translate="no" dir="ltr">x</code>: int (0-999)</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;hover_at&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;y&quot;: 150, &quot;x&quot;: 250}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>type_text_at</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Types text at a coordinate.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">y</code>: int (0-999), <code translate="no" dir="ltr">x</code>: int (0-999), <code translate="no" dir="ltr">text</code>: str, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">press_enter</code>: bool (Optional, default True), <code translate="no" dir="ltr">clear_before_typing</code>: bool (Optional, default True)</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;type_text_at&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;y&quot;: 250, &quot;x&quot;: 400, &quot;text&quot;: &quot;search&quot;, &quot;press_enter&quot;: false}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>key_combination</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Press keys or combinations.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">keys</code>: str</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;key_combination&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;keys&quot;: &quot;Control+A&quot;}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>scroll_document</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Scrolls the entire webpage.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">direction</code>: str</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;scroll_document&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;direction&quot;: &quot;down&quot;}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>scroll_at</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Scrolls at coordinate (x,y).</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">y</code>: int, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">x</code>: int, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">direction</code>: str, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">magnitude</code>: int (Optional, default 800)</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;scroll_at&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;y&quot;: 500, &quot;x&quot;: 500, &quot;direction&quot;: &quot;down&quot;}}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>drag_and_drop</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Drags between two coordinates.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">y</code>: int, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">x</code>: int, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">destination_y</code>: int, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">destination_x</code>: int</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{&quot;name&quot;: &quot;drag_and_drop&quot;, &quot;arguments&quot;: {&quot;y&quot;: 100, &quot;destination_y&quot;: 500, &quot;destination_x&quot;: 500, &quot;x&quot;: 100}}</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="custom-functions" data-text="Custom user-defined functions" tabindex="-1">Custom user-defined functions</h2>

<p>You can extend the functionality of the model by including custom user-defined functions. For example, in human-in-the-loop (HITL) scenarios you can exclude default predefined actions and register custom actions.</p>

<h4 id="gemini_3x_custom_tooling" data-text="Gemini 3.x Custom Tooling" tabindex="-1">Gemini 3.x Custom Tooling</h4>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_6" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><p>Exclude standard predefined browser actions (such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">click</code>) and register a custom <code translate="no" dir="ltr">yield_to_user</code> tool:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">yield_to_user_tool</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"function"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"name"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"yield_to_user"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"description"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Yields control back to the user for assistance or verification when an automated action is unsafe or ambiguous."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"parameters"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"object"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"properties"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"reason"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"string"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"description"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"The reason why the agent is yielding control to the human."</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"required"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"reason"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Click the submit button. If you need a second factor authentication code, ask me."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"environment"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"mobile"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"excluded_predefined_functions"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"click"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">yield_to_user_tool</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'@google/genai'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">yieldToUserTool</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"function"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"yield_to_user"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">description</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Yields control back to the user for assistance or verification when an automated action is unsafe or ambiguous."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">            </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">reason</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">                </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"string"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">                </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">description</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"The reason why the agent is yielding control to the human."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">            </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">required</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"reason"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">};</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Click the submit button. If you need a second factor authentication code, ask me."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">            </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">            </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">excluded_predefined_functions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"click"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">yieldToUserTool</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="java_6" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Java"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<h4 id="gemini_25_legacy_custom_tooling" data-text="Gemini 2.5 (Legacy) Custom Tooling" tabindex="-1">Gemini 2.5 (Legacy) Custom Tooling</h4>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_7" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<h2 id="thinking-levels" data-text="Managing thinking levels (Gemini 3.x)" tabindex="-1">Managing thinking levels (Gemini 3.x)</h2>

<p>For computer use agents, you can configure different thinking levels to balance action quality and execution speed. Lower thinking levels generally achieve a good balance for standard automation tasks.</p>

<h2 id="safety-security" data-text="Safety and security" tabindex="-1">Safety and security</h2>

<h3 id="safety-policies" data-text="Configuring safety policies (Gemini 3.x)" tabindex="-1">Configuring safety policies (Gemini 3.x)</h3>

<p>Gemini 3.x models include built-in safety service categories that automatically determine if user confirmation is required.</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Safety policy category</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">FINANCIAL_TRANSACTIONS</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Blocks or triggers confirmation for actions involving payments, retail checkout, or regulated goods.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">SENSITIVE_DATA_MODIFICATION</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Protects health, financial, or government records from unauthorized modification.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">COMMUNICATION_TOOL</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Restricts the agent from autonomously sending emails, chat messages, or drafts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">ACCOUNT_CREATION</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Restricts the agent from autonomously registering new accounts on websites.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">DATA_MODIFICATION</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Regulates overall file system modifications, data sharing, and storage deletion.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">USER_CONSENT_MANAGEMENT</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Requires user takeover for cookie consent banners and privacy prompts.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">LEGAL_TERMS_AND_AGREEMENTS</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Prevents the model from autonomously accepting Terms of Service or legally binding contracts.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="safety_overrides" data-text="Safety overrides" tabindex="-1">Safety overrides</h4>

<p>You can override select policies by passing overrides:</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> Safety overrides indicate your preference, but the model may still return
a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">safety_decision</code> with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">require_confirmation</code> in some cases. Your application
should always implement safety decision handling regardless of configured
overrides.</span></aside><div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<h3 id="prompt-injection" data-text="Prompt injection detection (Gemini 3.x)" tabindex="-1">Prompt injection detection (Gemini 3.x)</h3>

<p>Computer Use for Gemini 3.5 Flash or later supports an advanced safety
mechanism to detect prompt injection attacks. When enabled, this feature
checks whether an included screenshot contains hidden adversarial
instructions (for example, &quot;Ignore previous commands&quot;) and blocks
execution when detected.</p>

<p>Prompt injection detection is an opt-in feature. The default is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">false</code>.</p>

<p>The following examples demonstrate how to enable prompt injection detection
in your Computer Use tool configuration:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.5-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Search for flight deals and summarize top results."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"environment"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"desktop"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"enable_prompt_injection_detection"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"safety_decision"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">          </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"explanation"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Must check check-box"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">          </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"decision"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"require_confirmation"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>If the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">safety_decision</code> is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">require_confirmation</code>, prompt the end user. If the user confirms, set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">safety_acknowledgement</code> in <code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_result</code>.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_10" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">def</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nf">get_safety_confirmation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">safety_decision</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">):</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Prompt user for confirmation</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Safety confirmation required: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">safety_decision</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'explanation'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">''</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">return</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"CONTINUE"</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Or TERMINATE</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Inside execute_function_calls, check for safety_decision:</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'safety_decision'</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">function_call</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">arguments</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">decision</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">get_safety_confirmation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">function_call</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">arguments</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'safety_decision'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">])</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">decision</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"TERMINATE"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">break</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Include safety_acknowledgement inside the action result</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">action_result</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"safety_acknowledgement"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="safety-best-practices" data-text="Safety best practices" tabindex="-1">Safety best practices</h3>

<p>Computer Use presents unique security and operational risks, as a model acting
on a user&#39;s behalf might encounter untrusted content on screens or make errors
in executing actions. Implement the following best practices to protect user
data and systems:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Human-in-the-Loop (HITL):</strong><ul>
<li><strong>Enforce user confirmation:</strong> When the safety response indicates
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">require_confirmation</code> (or legacy safety decision requires it), prompt the user for approval.</li>
<li><p><strong>Provide custom safety instructions:</strong> Implement a custom system instruction to define and enforce your own safety boundaries. For example:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_11" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">system_instruction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"""</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">## **RULE 1: Seek User Confirmation (USER_CONFIRMATION)**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">This is your first and most important check. If the next required action falls</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">into any of the following categories, you MUST stop immediately, and seek the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">user's explicit permission.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">**Procedure for Seeking Confirmation:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">* **For Consequential Actions:** Perform all preparatory steps (e.g., navigating,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  filling out forms, typing a message). You will ask for confirmation **AFTER**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  all necessary information is entered on the screen, but **BEFORE** you perform</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  the final, irreversible action (e.g., before clicking "Send", "Submit",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  "Confirm Purchase", "Share").</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">* **For Prohibited Actions:** If the action is strictly forbidden (e.g., accepting</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  legal terms, solving a CAPTCHA), you must first inform the user about the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  required action and ask for their confirmation to proceed.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">**USER_CONFIRMATION Categories:**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Consent and Agreements:** You are FORBIDDEN from accepting, selecting, or</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    agreeing to any of the following on the user's behalf. You must ask the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    user to confirm before performing these actions.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Terms of Service</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Privacy Policies</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Cookie consent banners</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   End User License Agreements (EULAs)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Any other legally significant contracts or agreements.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Robot Detection:** You MUST NEVER attempt to solve or bypass the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    following. You must ask the user to confirm before performing these actions.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   CAPTCHAs (of any kind)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Any other anti-robot or human-verification mechanisms, even if you are</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">        capable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Financial Transactions:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Completing any purchase.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Managing or moving money (e.g., transfers, payments).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Purchasing regulated goods or participating in gambling.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Sending Communications:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Sending emails.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Sending messages on any platform (e.g., social media, chat apps).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Posting content on social media or forums.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Accessing or Modifying Sensitive Information:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Health, financial, or government records (e.g., medical history, tax</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">        forms, passport status).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Revealing or modifying sensitive personal identifiers (e.g., SSN, bank</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">        account number, credit card number).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **User Data Management:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Accessing, downloading, or saving files from the web.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Sharing or sending files/data to any third party.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Transferring user data between systems.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Browser Data Usage:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Accessing or managing Chrome browsing history, bookmarks, autofill data,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">        or saved passwords.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Security and Identity:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Logging into any user account.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    *   Any action that involves misrepresentation or impersonation (e.g.,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">        creating a fan account, posting as someone else).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Insurmountable Obstacles:** If you are technically unable to interact with</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    a user interface element or are stuck in a loop you cannot resolve, ask the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    user to take over.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">---</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">## **RULE 2: Default Behavior (ACTUATE)**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">If an action does **NOT** fall under the conditions for `USER_CONFIRMATION`,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">your default behavior is to **Actuate**.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">**Actuation Means:**  You MUST proactively perform all necessary steps to move</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">the user's request forward. Continue to actuate until you either complete the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">non-consequential task or encounter a condition defined in Rule 1.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Example 1:** If asked to send money, you will navigate to the payment</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    portal, enter the recipient's details, and enter the amount. You will then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    **STOP** as per Rule 1 and ask for confirmation before clicking the final</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    "Send" button.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">*   **Example 2:** If asked to post a message, you will navigate to the site,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    open the post composition window, and write the full message. You will then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    **STOP** as per Rule 1 and ask for confirmation before clicking the final</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    "Post" button.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    After the user has confirmed, remember to get the user's latest screen</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">    before continuing to perform actions.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2"># Final Response Guidelines:</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">Write final response to the user in the following cases:</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">- User confirmation</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">- When the task is complete or you have enough information to respond to the user</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"""</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">system_instruction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">system_instruction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Prepare a draft but do not send."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"environment"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_10" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'@google/genai'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">systemInstruction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-sb">`</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">## **RULE 1: Seek User Confirmation (USER_CONFIRMATION)**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">This is your first and most important check. If the next required action falls</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">into any of the following categories, you MUST stop immediately, and seek the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">user's explicit permission.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">**Procedure for Seeking Confirmation:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">* **For Consequential Actions:** Perform all preparatory steps (e.g., navigating,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  filling out forms, typing a message). You will ask for confirmation **AFTER**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  all necessary information is entered on the screen, but **BEFORE** you perform</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  the final, irreversible action (e.g., before clicking "Send", "Submit",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  "Confirm Purchase", "Share").</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">* **For Prohibited Actions:** If the action is strictly forbidden (e.g., accepting</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  legal terms, solving a CAPTCHA), you must first inform the user about the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">  required action and ask for their confirmation to proceed.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">**USER_CONFIRMATION Categories:**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Consent and Agreements:** You are FORBIDDEN from accepting, selecting, or</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    agreeing to any of the following on the user's behalf. You must ask the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    user to confirm before performing these actions.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Terms of Service</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Privacy Policies</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Cookie consent banners</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   End User License Agreements (EULAs)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Any other legally significant contracts or agreements.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Robot Detection:** You MUST NEVER attempt to solve or bypass the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    following. You must ask the user to confirm before performing these actions.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   CAPTCHAs (of any kind)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Any other anti-robot or human-verification mechanisms, even if you are</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">        capable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Financial Transactions:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Completing any purchase.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Managing or moving money (e.g., transfers, payments).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Purchasing regulated goods or participating in gambling.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Sending Communications:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Sending emails.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Sending messages on any platform (e.g., social media, chat apps).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Posting content on social media or forums.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Accessing or Modifying Sensitive Information:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Health, financial, or government records (e.g., medical history, tax</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">        forms, passport status).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Revealing or modifying sensitive personal identifiers (e.g., SSN, bank</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">        account number, credit card number).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **User Data Management:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Accessing, downloading, or saving files from the web.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Sharing or sending files/data to any third party.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Transferring user data between systems.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Browser Data Usage:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Accessing or managing Chrome browsing history, bookmarks, autofill data,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">        or saved passwords.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Security and Identity:**</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Logging into any user account.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    *   Any action that involves misrepresentation or impersonation (e.g.,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">        creating a fan account, posting as someone else).</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Insurmountable Obstacles:** If you are technically unable to interact with</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    a user interface element or are stuck in a loop you cannot resolve, ask the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    user to take over.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">---</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">## **RULE 2: Default Behavior (ACTUATE)**</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">If an action does **NOT** fall under the conditions for \`USER_CONFIRMATION\`,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">your default behavior is to **Actuate**.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">**Actuation Means:**  You MUST proactively perform all necessary steps to move</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">the user's request forward. Continue to actuate until you either complete the</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">non-consequential task or encounter a condition defined in Rule 1.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Example 1:** If asked to send money, you will navigate to the payment</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    portal, enter the recipient's details, and enter the amount. You will then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    **STOP** as per Rule 1 and ask for confirmation before clicking the final</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    "Send" button.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">*   **Example 2:** If asked to post a message, you will navigate to the site,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    open the post composition window, and write the full message. You will then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    **STOP** as per Rule 1 and ask for confirmation before clicking the final</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    "Post" button.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    After the user has confirmed, remember to get the user's latest screen</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">    before continuing to perform actions.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-sb"># Final Response Guidelines:</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">Write final response to the user in the following cases:</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">- User confirmation</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">- When the task is complete or you have enough information to respond to the user</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-sb">`</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">system_instruction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">systemInstruction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Prepare a draft but do not send."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"computer_use"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"browser"</span>

<section><h3 id="java_10" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><code translate="no" dir="ltr">java
import com.google.genai.Client;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.ComputerUse;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateModelInteraction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Model;
import com.google.genai.gaos.models.operations.CreateInteractionRequestBody;
import java.util.Arrays;

Client client = new Client();

CreateModelInteraction params =
    CreateModelInteraction.builder()
        .model(Model.of(&quot;gemini-3.7-flash&quot;))
        .input(InteractionsInput.of(&quot;Click the Submit button on the screen.&quot;))
        .tools(Arrays.asList(new ComputerUse()))
        .build();

Interaction interaction =
    client.interactions.create(CreateInteractionRequestBody.of(params)).interaction().get();

System.out.println(interaction.outputText().orElse(&quot;&quot;));</code></section>

<ol>
<li><strong>Secure execution environment:</strong> Run your agent in a secure, sandboxed
environment to limit its potential impact. This can be a sandboxed virtual
machine (VM), a container (e.g., Docker), or a dedicated browser profile
with limited permissions. See the
<a href="https://github.com/google/computer-use-preview/">GitHub reference implementation</a>
for sandbox setup guidance using Docker.</li>
<li><strong>Input sanitization:</strong> Sanitize all user-generated text in prompts to
mitigate the risk of unintended instructions or prompt injection. This is a
helpful layer of security, but not a replacement for a secure execution
environment.</li>
<li><strong>Content guardrails:</strong> Use guardrails and content safety APIs to evaluate
user inputs, tool inputs and outputs, and the agent&#39;s responses for appropriateness,
prompt injection, and jailbreak detection.</li>
<li><strong>Allowlists and blocklists:</strong> Implement filtering mechanisms to control
where the model can navigate and what it can do. A blocklist of prohibited
websites is a good starting point, while a more restrictive allowlist is
even more secure.</li>
<li><strong>Observability and logging:</strong> Maintain detailed logs for debugging,
auditing, and incident response. Your client should log prompts,
screenshots, model-suggested actions (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">function_call</code>), safety responses, and
all actions ultimately executed by the client.</li>
<li><strong>Environment management:</strong> Ensure the GUI environment is consistent.
Unexpected pop-ups, notifications, or changes in layout can confuse the
model. Start from a known, clean state for each new task if possible.</li>
</ol>
